maria: noticed console-run requests showing up billed to SA project in route dashboard, not the project selected in UI.

simon: Is that the impersonation flow? Console sets an `X-Effective-Project` header, right?

maria: yes. emitter currently prefers token sa claim. effective_project is ignored.

lee: quick fix options: (1) emitter prefers X-Effective-Project, (2) post-process billing.

simon: prefer (1). simpler and immediate. gate behind flag. validate input.

maria: plan: emitter priority = effective_project -> service_account -> org. feature flag canary in staging then prod.

ops-bot: deploy: feature/attr-effective-project CANARY in staging at 1719510040.

lee: also add metric `attribution_source` with values [effective_project, service_account, org, unknown] and `effective_project_validation_fail` counter.

sre-zoe: note: quota enforcement uses the token key. keep separate counters `enforced_by_key` vs `billed_to_project` to avoid alert confusion.

maria: good call. I'll update console label to show both billed project and token origin. we should also add both fields to route exports for audits.

simon: i'll take emitter + validation PR. maria will handle UI copy and export docs. lee wires metrics and dashboard.
